text: The purpose of this report is to provide the annual summary of the City's employer contributions submitted to OMERS in 2018 and to provide information on the City's total members and contributions relative to the overall OMERS Plan members and contributions.
City Council on July 16, 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (June 10, 2019) from the Controller for information.
